name: Safrochain Hub Mobile App
shortDescription: Official Safrochain mobile wallet — swap, bridge, stake, and manage SAF on iOS and Android.
description: Safrochain Hub Mobile App is the official mobile wallet for the Safrochain ecosystem. Send and receive SAF, swap SAF/USDC, bridge assets across Safrochain, Osmosis, and Noble, stake with validators, and explore ecosystem dApps — all from your phone with WalletConnect signing.
